lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. These clusters are arranged in a periodic 2D grid spanning the mid-lateral flank, with approximately 4-6 distinct spots per vertical column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming discrete nodes of high luminance at each intersection across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from high luminance on the superior surface to shadowed low luminance on the inferior surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration of pixels along the leading (anterior) edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density aggregation of approximately 25-30 commensal fish is visible in the water column directly ventral to the right pectoral fin.
